sloka: रञ्जनीयं हि भर्तारं विनष्टमवगम्य सा।नैराश्यात् स्त्रीलघुत्वाच्च त्वद्वशं प्रतिपत्स्यते ।। ६.६४.३३ ।।
transliteration: rañjanīyaṁ hi bhartāraṁ vinaṣṭamavagamya sā।nairāśyāt strīlaghutvācca tvadvaśaṁ pratipatsyate ।। 6.64.33 ।।

translations.english: "Her charming husband ceased to live and thinking of no alternate, being a fickle woman, will accept your dependence."
